data.name: Manifestation
data.description: The shaman becomes the spirit of heaven. She receives a bonus on all saving throws equal to +%1. She automatically stabilizes if she is reduced to below 0 hit points. She's immune to fear effects, and she automatically confirms all critical hits she threatens. If she dies, she's reborn 3 days later in the form of a star child, maturing over the course of 7 days (as reincarnate).|ShamanHeavensManifestationBonus
